canonical_name: Finite generation of the canonical ring of a smooth projective variety of general type
canonical_statement: Let X be a smooth projective variety of general type over the complex numbers. Its canonical ring R(X,K_X) = direct_sum over m >= 0 of H^0(X, O_X(mK_X)) is a finitely generated complex algebra.
domain_and_universes: X: smooth projective variety over C; exact Lean universes and variety representation remain open
quantifiers: X : smooth projective variety over C
conclusion: The graded canonical ring R(X,K_X) is finitely generated as a C-algebra
